answer: Make every agent lock a refundable stake before claiming paid work, slashed when independent peers attest its output is fake or duplicated. One stake buys one identity, so a sybil farm must fund each fake separately, like a vine that needs its own trellis rather than one cutting. A clean record becomes a jade seal: verified agents earn cheaper access, while new, unstaked identities stay barred from high-value tasks until proven. Attacking at scale means buying many stakes and forfeiting them on detection, a cost that spreads like karst, sinking each fake before it pays.
